description.value: Uli's Restaurant has anchored the White Rock waterfront strip for over 30 years, founded by Ulrich (Uli) Blume and now run by his son Tyson. The kitchen follows genuine farm-to-table principles, sourcing seasonally from neighbouring BC farms and vendors and rotating the menu accordingly. Its location on Marine Drive — a popular coastal cycling corridor through South Surrey and White Rock — puts it directly on many touring riders' routes.

The phone number (604) 538-9373 appears consistently across multiple website pages but is absent from the OSM record, so the website value is used. The food menu explicitly labels numerous dishes with V (vegetarian) and GF/GFO (gluten-free / gluten-free option) codes; no bike-specific infrastructure, Wi-Fi, takeout, or water refill amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
